newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT denies it in talks with C&W on int'l alliance.
newsitem.headline: NTT denies it in talks with C&W on int'l alliance.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp on Monday denied a media report that it is in talks with Cable and Wireless Plc on an international alliance.
"We are not considering a joint venture or mutual shareholdings with specific telecommunications carriers," an NTT spokeswoman said.
She reiterated NTT's stance that it would not enter into exclusive alliances with specific telecommunications carriers, although NTT is ready to cooperate with them on individual projects.

She made the comments after Britain's Sunday Telegraph reported that NTT's international wing could merge with Japanese long-distance carrier International Digital Communications, of which C&W has an 18 percent stake.
The paper added that C&W chief executive Richard Brown had been discussing an even closer link with NTT, involving either a joint company or mutual shareholdings.
